summary: Bundle elimination for STMT-ACT-SIMPLY-PRIOR-TO-POTENCY (#497, third slice, method after #498). Source: Metaphysics XII.6 materialized from the pinned ARIST-MET-XII-6 witness and read whole (1071b3-1072a18). The recorded rival STMT-POTENCY-PRIOR-TO-ACT is the bare contradictory. The position Aristotle reports has two parts: the aporia (1071b22-24: whatever acts is able, but not everything able acts, so potency is prior) and its proponents, the theologians who generate from Night and the physicists' 'all things together' (1071b26-28). Formalized commitment (new claim ARIST-MET-1071B-NIGHT-GENERATION-A, weakest reading): some potency that no being in act simply precedes is actualized (STMT-NIGHT-UNPRECEDED-POTENCY-ACTUALIZED); Aristotle's question 'how will it be moved?' presupposes the actualization. Bundle: TruthCore.Comparison.NightCosmogony.GenerationFromNight; it entails the bare rival (bundleEntailsRival). Not formalized, with reasons: the aporia's grounds constrain only ability and act, not PriorSimply, so they cannot enter a core against the target; Aristotle's modal reply 'nothing that is will be' (1071b24-26) and the eternity-of-motion argument (1071b6-22) need modal and temporal vocabulary the case lacks; the temporal reading of 'prior' (Night first in time, 1072a7-8) is rejected as a rival reading because Aquinas grants temporal priority of potency within one changing thing (ST I q.3 a.1 co.), recorded in DISAMB-PRIORITY-SIMPLE-OR-IN-TIME with DEF-PRIORITY-IN-TIME. Certified (zero axioms): bundle ∪ Γ ⊢ False with Γ = {STMT-NOTHING-REDUCED-TO-ACT-EXCEPT-BY-A-BEING-IN-ACT (new supporting claim ARIST-MET-1071B-MOTION-NEEDS-ACTUAL-CAUSE-A, 1071b12-14, 28-29), STMT-NOTHING-MOVES-ITSELF-IN-SAME-RESPECT (reused; new supporting claim ARIST-MET-1071B-MATTER-NOT-SELF-MOVER-A, 1071b29-31), STMT-ACTUAL-MOVER-IS-SIMPLY-PRIOR (new open bridge, unattributed: the step from 'moved by a cause in actuality' to 'act is prior', 1072a4)}, without the target premise. Γ is inclusion-minimal: MODEL-NIGHT-COSMOGONY-NO-REDUCTION, -SELF-MOVER and -OTHER-MOVER satisfy the bundle with each pair. The stronger bridge 'every mover is simply prior to what it moves' (suggested in ActPotencyPremisesIndependent's doc comment) was rejected for the weakest one that suffices, restricted to actual movers of another's potency: with STMT-NOTHING-PRIOR-TO-ITSELF the stronger one excludes every self-mover, which Plato's self-moving soul in this same chapter (1071b37-1072a3) affirms. Alternative core from root-path premises (coreFromRootPremises): STMT-NOTHING-REDUCED-TO-ACT-EXCEPT-BY-A-MOVER, STMT-NOTHING-MOVES-EXCEPT-AS-IN-ACT, STMT-NOTHING-IN-ACT-AND-POTENCY-IN-SAME-RESPECT and the same bridge. Residual: the bare rival survives Γ (MODEL-NIGHT-COSMOGONY-RESIDUAL, rivalSurvivesCore): an unpreceded potency that is never actualized, the gap of #352 finding 4. Closed core members: none. Floor classification (#497 criteria). STMT-NOTHING-REDUCED-TO-ACT-EXCEPT-BY-A-BEING-IN-ACT: logical no (MovedIn, MovesIn, InAct are parameters; removal model); retorsion no (its denial is consistent and asserting it presupposes nothing it denies); common_ground no (it entails STMT-NOTHING-REDUCED-TO-ACT-EXCEPT-BY-A-MOVER, whose recorded rivals STMT-CHANGE-WITHOUT-ANY-MOVER and STMT-INERTIAL-UNIFORM-MOTION-WITHOUT-MOVER deny it, and the Night proponents themselves deny it); observation no (a general principle). STMT-NOTHING-MOVES-ITSELF-IN-SAME-RESPECT: logical no (removal model); retorsion no; common_ground no (the Scotist self-motion rival STMT-ACT-AND-POTENCY-IN-SAME-RESPECT and Plato's self-mover, 1071b37-1072a3, deny it; neither has a pinned witness of the denial); observation no. STMT-ACTUAL-MOVER-IS-SIMPLY-PRIOR: logical no (removal model); retorsion no; common_ground candidate only if each recorded rival is shown by sourced claims to accept it, and none is; observation no. It is the cheapest member to source: candidates are Metaphysics IX.8, 1049b24-29 and 1050a4-b6 (priority of act in substance), or a sourced 'a mover is an efficient cause' bridge composed with STMT-EFFICIENT-CAUSE-IS-PRIOR-TO-EFFECT. No refutes relation recorded (#391). Frontier delta: none.
blocker: Closing the core needs all three members closed: STMT-ACTUAL-MOVER-IS-SIMPLY-PRIOR sourced and defended (Metaphysics IX.8 is the next text), STMT-NOTHING-REDUCED-TO-ACT-EXCEPT-BY-A-BEING-IN-ACT defended against the indeterminist and inertial rivals, and STMT-NOTHING-MOVES-ITSELF-IN-SAME-RESPECT against the self-motion rivals. Even then the bare rival STMT-POTENCY-PRIOR-TO-ACT survives as an unactualized unpreceded potency; eliminating it needs a sourced rival theory for that residue or a sourced premise that every potency is related to some actualization.
